name: 柔蒂亚克：永眠之城
detailed_description:
Game Introduction

This is a visual novel game with a sci-fi adventure theme, primarily based on dialogue options. In all cities, humanity has fallen into an unawakable dream, and you are one of the few "lucky" ones who remain awake. During a search for supplies in the city, you encounter a sudden hunt, and at a critical moment, a mysterious girl saves you...

In the game, you will need to complete the following tasks:

  • Explore the girl's inner thoughts through numerous dialogue options.

  • Help the girl recover her lost memories.

  • Investigate the true reason behind humanity's deep slumber.

  • Ensure that you are on the right path and make the correct choices.

  • Beware, some choices could be a matter of life or death!

Game Features

Sci-Fi Interactive Elements — Zodiac: The Eversleeping World is a visual novel game set in a sci-fi theme. You find yourself in a dilapidated city where rust creeps wildly between towering buildings. Apart from your own breathing, the only sounds are the whirring of unmanned drones and the glowing red of the alien structures at the city's center. What has happened here? It’s up to you to explore!

Multidimensional Narrative — Step into The Eversleeping World and experience a thrilling and emotionally charged narrative adventure! In this branching story world, every choice you make will lead you to a distinctly different fate, and the montage-style storytelling will allow you to shift perspectives, including your own, revealing that anyone could be just the tip of the iceberg of the truth.

Visual Feast — The initial design of Zodiac is crafted by a team that has worked on popular titles like Honor of Kings and Arknights. He Yu Wen Stone is a leading domestic art design company that boasts a visual team from Hollywood, creating game CGs and various virtual character IPs that stand out in the industry.

Immersive Audio-Visual Experience — To bring each character to life, we have invited renowned voice actors to provide the voices for the characters. Their participation will infuse the game with soul. A specific list of voice actors will be announced later, so stay tuned. Follow the cues from their voices to experience a deeper layer of storytelling.

The game features a text volume of 60000 words, including over five different endings.

Soon you fell into a hunting game, running through the empty streets. At this moment, a strange girl appeared...
